  CORPORATE
   PROFILE
        公司簡介




China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”; stock code: 2319) and its subsidiaries
(collectively the “Group” or “Mengniu”) mainly manufacture and distribute quality dairy products in
China. It is one of the leading dairy product manufacturers in China, with MENGNIU as its core
brand. Mengniu offers diversified products including liquid milk products, ice cream, milk formula and
cheese. Mengniu ranked 8th in the 2023 “Global Dairy Top 20” list published by Rabobank. As of
31 December 2023, the Group’s annual dairy production capacity reached 14.04 million tons. In
March 2014, Mengniu became a Hang Seng Index constituent, making it the first blue chip Chinese
dairy product manufacturer. In 2023, Mengniu’s MSCI ESG rating was elevated to AA, distinguishing
it as the only comprehensive dairy company in China to achieve this rating. Mengniu is a constituent
of the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Index, Hang Seng (Mainland and HK) Corporate
Sustainability Index, Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index and HSI ESG Enhanced
Select Index.

中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子公司（統稱「本集團」或「蒙牛」）主要於中
國生產及銷售優質乳製品。憑藉其主要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品生產商之一。蒙牛提
供多元化的產品，包括液態奶、冰淇淋、奶粉及奶酪產品。蒙牛於荷蘭合作銀行公佈的二零二三年「全
球乳業二十強」中排名第八。截至二零二三年十二月三十一日，本集團乳製品的年生產能力達1,404萬
噸。 二零一四年三月，蒙牛獲納入恒生指數成份股，成為首家中國乳製品企業藍籌股。二零二三年，
蒙牛MSCI ESG評級躍升至AA級，成為中國唯一一家取得AA評級的綜合型乳製品企業，並入選恒生可
持續發展企業指數、恒生內地及香港可持續發展企業指數、恒生可持續發展企業基準指數及恒指ESG
增強精選指數。

                 Impairment of financial assets                                      金融資產減值
                 The Group recognises an allowance for expected                      本集團就所有並非按公允值計入損益
                 credit losses (“ECLs”) for all debt instruments not held            持有的債務工具確認預期信貸虧損
                 at fair value through profit or loss. ECLs are based on            （「預期信貸虧損」）。預期信貸虧損乃
                 the difference between the contractual cash flows due               以根據合約應付的合約現金流量與本
                 in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows              集團預期收取的所有現金流量之間的
                 that the Group expects to receive, discounted at an                 差額為基準，按原有實際利率相近的
                 approximation of the original effective interest rate. The          差額貼現。預期現金流量將包括來自
                 expected cash flows will include cash flows from the                銷售所持有抵押品或其他信用增級的
                 sale of collateral held or other credit enhancements                現金流量，此乃合約條款不可或缺的
                 that are integral to the contractual terms.                         部分。

                 General approach                                                   一般方法
                 ECLs are recognised in two stages. For credit                      預期信貸虧損於兩個階段進行確認。
                 exposures for which there has not been a significant               對於自初始確認後並無顯著增加的信
                 increase in credit risk since initial recognition, ECLs            貸風險，預期信貸虧損就可能於未來
                 are provided for credit losses that result from default            12個 月 內 出 現 的 違 約 事 件 計 提 撥 備
                 events that are possible within the next 12 months (a              （12個月預期信貸虧損）。對於自初始
                 12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which                確認後有顯著增加的信貸風險，須在
                 there has been a significant increase in credit risk               信貸虧損預期的剩餘年期計提虧損撥
                 since initial recognition, a loss allowance is required            備，不論違約事件於何時發生（存續
                 for credit losses expected over the remaining life of              期預期信貸虧損）。
                 the exposure, irrespective of the timing of the default
                 (a lifetime ECL).

                  At each reporting date, the Group assesses whether                於各報告日期，本集團評估自初始確
                  the credit risk on a financial instrument has increased           認後金融工具的信貸風險是否顯著增
                  significantly since initial recognition. When making the          加。本集團作出評估時會對於報告日
                  assessment, the Group compares the risk of a default              期金融工具發生的違約風險及於初始
                  occurring on the financial instrument as at the                   確認日期起金融工具發生的違約風險
                  reporting date with the risk of a default occurring on            進行比較，並考慮無需付出不必要成
                  the financial instrument as at the date of initial                本或努力而可得到的合理及可支持資
                  recognition and considers reasonable and supportable              料，包括歷史及前瞻性資料。
                  information that is available without undue cost or
                  effort, including historical and forward-looking
                  information.

37 SHARE OPTION SCHEME                                             37 購股權計劃
   The Company operated share option scheme (the “Share              本 公 司 設 立 的 購 股 權 計 劃（「 購 股 權 計
   Option Scheme”) for the purpose of providing incentives           劃」），目的為激勵對本集團業務成功作出
   and rewards to eligible participants who contribute to the        貢獻的合資格參與者，並向彼等作出獎賞。
   success of the Group’s operations. Eligible participants of       購股權計劃的合資格計劃參與者包括本公
   the Share Option Schemes include the Company’s                    司董事（包括獨立非執行董事）、本集團之
   directors, including independent non-executive directors,         其他僱員、本集團之貨品或服務供應商、
   other employees of the Group, suppliers of goods or               客戶以及向本集團提供研究、開發或技術
   services to the Group, customers and any person or entity         支援的任何人士或實體。
   that provides research, development or technological
   support to the Group.

   The offer of a grant of share options may be accepted             承授人可以支付代價合共1港元後接納授出
   upon payment of a consideration of HK$1 in total by the           購股權建議。授出購股權的行使期由董事
   grantee. The exercise period of the share options granted is      會決定，行使期由某一歸屬期後起計及在
   determinable by the directors, and commences after a              不遲於授出購股權建議日五年之日終止。
   certain vesting period and ends on a date which is not later
   than five years from the date of offer of the share options.

   The exercise price of share options is determinable by the        購股權行使價由董事釐定，惟不可低於(i)本
   directors, but may not be less than the highest of (i) the        公司股份於授出購股權建議之日在聯交所
   Stock Exchange’s closing price of the Company’s shares on         所報的收市價(ii)本公司股份於緊接建議授
   the offer date of the share options; (ii) the average Stock       出日期前五個營業日在聯交所所報的平均
   Exchange closing price of the Company’s shares for the five       收市價；及(iii)股份面值最高者。
   business days immediately preceding the offer date; and (iii)
   the nominal value of the shares.

38 SHARE AWARD SCHEME                                                38 股票獎勵計劃
  The share award scheme of the Company was adopted by                     本公司股票獎勵計劃於二零一三年三月
  the board on 26 March 2013 (the “Adoption Date”). The                    二十六日（「採納日期」）獲董事會採納。股
  purpose of the share award scheme is to provide an                       票獎勵計劃旨在獎勵參與者繼續為本集團
  incentive to encourage the participants for the continual                的經營及發展作出貢獻。
  operation and development of the Group.

  Subject to the terms of the share award scheme and the                   根據股票獎勵計劃條款及上市規則，董事
  Listing Rules, the board may at any time make an offer to                會可隨時向任何合資格人士作出要約，由
  any eligible person whom it may in its absolute discretion               合資格人士絕對酌情選擇接納董事會決定
  select to accept the grant of an award over such a number                授出的有關股份數目之獎勵（「參與者」）。
  of shares as it may determine (the “Participants”). Existing             股票獎勵計劃的獨立受託人（「受託人」）以
  shares of the Company will be purchased by an                            本集團出資的現金於市場上購買本公司現
  independent trustee (the “Trustee”) of the share award                   有股份，及以信託形式代相關參與者持有，
  scheme from the market out of cash contributed by the                    直至該等股份根據股票獎勵計劃的條文歸
  Group and be held in trust for the relevant Participants until           屬於相關參與為止。已授出及由受託人持
  such shares are vested with the relevant Participants in                 有直至歸屬的本公司股份稱為庫存股份，
  accordance with the provisions of the share award scheme.                而各庫存股份應指本公司一股普通股。
  The shares of the Company granted and held by the
  trustee until vesting are referred to as the treasury shares
  and each treasury share shall represent one ordinary share

   (g)   Capital management                                              (g)   資本管理
         The primary objectives of the Group’s capital                         本集團資本管理的基本目標乃維持本

         maximise shareholders’ value.

         The Group manages its capital structure and makes                     本集團管理其資本架構，並因應經濟
         adjustments to it in light of changes in economic                     環境的變化及相關資產的風險特徵作
         conditions and the risk characteristics of the                        出調整。為維持或調整資本架構，本
